newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils close firmer but in the doldrums.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils close firmer but in the doldrums.

text.p: European vegetable oil closed firmer but activity was sluggish due to traders' uncertainty over the short-term direction.
The palm oil sector closed $5 above Wednesday's close following a higher finish on Malaysian palm oil futures.
A few trades were reported during the afternoon session, with Nov, Dec and Jan/Mar crude palm oil all traded at $525 and one trade on olein at $525 for Jan/Mar.
Soy and rape oil traders were unsure over what to do next following the erratic early trading on the Chicago soybean oil futures. On Wednesday Chicago closed firmer.
One trade was noted on soy oil at 93 guilders for Feb/Apr material.
The lauric oils ended $5 up but only managed one trade on palmkernel oil at $687.50 for Oct/Nov.
